subject.title: [Feature]: Feishu: send text + multiple images as a single interactive card

question: Should Feishu text or presentation plus image attachments automatically collapse into one interactive image card, or should senders opt in with an explicit Feishu-scoped option and defined image-card limits?
rationale: The missing behavior is clear in source, but changing the default send shape and exposing safe card image composition is a product and channel-safety decision rather than a strict bug repair.

options.title: Opt-in image cards
options.body: Add a Feishu-scoped opt-in first so existing text-plus-media sends keep sequential behavior unless the sender requests a card, with bounded image limits and sequential fallback.

options.title: Automatic image cards
options.body: Automatically compose one card whenever Feishu sends include text or presentation plus image attachments, accepting the default behavior change with explicit fallback proof.

options.title: Wait for generic presentation images
options.body: Defer the feature until the shared presentation contract grows a cross-channel image block instead of adding a Feishu-first send option.

recommendation.title: Opt-in image cards
recommendation.body: Add a Feishu-scoped opt-in first so existing text-plus-media sends keep sequential behavior unless the sender requests a card, with bounded image limits and sequential fallback.

likelyOwner.reason: m1heng is the declared Feishu plugin community owner and was already pulled into this Feishu-specific product decision on the issue timeline.
